facts.business: Ramsons Projects Limited is a company that ceased to be a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) effective September 17, 2025, and currently has no revenue from operations, earning income primarily from non-operating sources.

key_risks: The growth of the Company's business is linked to the overall economic growth, infrastructure development and stability in the real estate sector.
Any adverse changes in government policies, regulatory framework, market conditions or economic environment may affect the business operations of the Company.
Fluctuations in real estate demand, delays in project execution, legal/regulatory approvals and volatility markets may also impact the operational and financial performance of the Company.
